# Cancer Rehab PT

> > Online physical therapy education and rehabilitation programs for cancer survivors and lymphedema management, led by Board-Certified Oncology Specialist Kelly Sturm, CLT-LANA.

Cancer Rehab PT provides evidence-based online rehabilitation programs, continuing education courses, and patient education resources specializing in cancer recovery, lymphedema management, and post-surgical rehabilitation. The platform is founded and led by Kelly Sturm, a Doctor of Physical Therapy with specialized certifications in oncology and lymphatic therapy.

## Key Topics

- Cancer Rehabilitation
- Lymphedema Management
- Breast Cancer Recovery
- Oncology Physical Therapy
- Manual Lymphatic Drainage
- Post-Surgical Recovery
- Shoulder Pain Treatment
- Lymphatic Drainage Exercises
- Board-Certified Oncology Specialist
- Certified Lymphedema Therapist (CLT-LANA)
- Physical Therapy Programs
- Patient Education
- Continuing Education
- Radiation Fibrosis Treatment

## Rehabilitation Programs

- [Breast Cancer Physical Therapy Program](https://cancerrehabpt.com/breast-cancer-rehab): Online breast cancer rehabilitation program for strength and quality of life
- [Breast Cancer Patient Education Collection](https://cancerrehabpt.com/breast-cancer-rehab-collection): Comprehensive breast cancer education and physical therapy exercise library
- [Lower Body Lymphedema Rehab Program](https://cancerrehabpt.com/lower-body-lymphedema-rehab): Leg lymphedema treatment program to minimize swelling and maximize function
- [Healthy Shoulder Program](https://cancerrehabpt.com/healthy-shoulder-program): Online shoulder pain recovery program for post-cancer rehabilitation
- [Lymphedema Patient Education Bundle](https://cancerrehabpt.com/lymphedema-patient-education-bundle): Lymphedema management and physical therapy handouts for clinical resources

## Professional Education & Events

- [Cancer Rehab Continuing Education - Courses & Events](https://cancerrehabpt.com/courses-and-events): Evidence-based continuing education courses and virtual conference for professionals

## Educational Resources & Blog

- [Cancer and Lymphedema Blog](https://cancerrehabpt.com/blog): Educational blog on cancer rehabilitation and lymphedema management
- [15 Minute Full Body Morning Lymphatic Drainage Routine](https://cancerrehabpt.com/blog/morning-lymphatic-drainage-routine): 15-minute guided lymphatic drainage routine by Kelly Sturm with video
- [How Long Should You Wear Compression Socks for Swelling?](https://cancerrehabpt.com/blog/how-long-should-you-wear-compression-socks): Guide on compression sock wear duration for lymphedema and swelling management
- [Radiation Fibrosis: How to Treat It with Physical Therapy](https://cancerrehabpt.com/blog/radiation-fibrosis): Treatment guide for radiation fibrosis using physical therapy techniques
